name: Gojōme (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Gojōme town emblem in white: a cog-like ring of five notched segments enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Gojōme, a town in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1951.

features.role: Gojōme town emblem — a cog-like ring of five notched segments enclosing a ring
